notes.title: New Content & Discounts!
notes.content:
We've got significant discounts on the Seven Realms collection to celebrate Steam's Visual Novel Fest!

You can also play the first small part of the character side paths in The Seven Realms: High Lathión.

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/46365/

This new release contains the first batch of side paths, including Part 1 for Gina, Kagome & Yuki. We will release the remaining side paths ahead of Realm 4's release later this year.

To experience all content in this release, play Gina's path on both a demon ally and a witch ally save. You will also get more out of Kagome's scene on a demon ally save.

To access the side paths, load a save from the very end of High Lathión's main story or play again up to the end. The side path menu will automatically appear after the main story's final cinematic.

Enjoy!

notes.title: High Lathión - Demo Now Available!
notes.content:
As part of Steam Next Fest, we have launched a demo for The Seven Realms - High Lathión.

This demo covers around the first hour of the game, with three achievements to unlock, two lewd scenes to encounter and to preview our new glossary and updated user interface.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44640344/903511f2b673e2b52c2ecb15281549659cbb52fb.jpg
For players coming from our Patreon, you can also check out the immersive recap for the first time in this demo. This recaps the choices of the previous chapters and allows you to simulate your choices to fast-track a save into High Lathión.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44640344/fa4d3d22f1908ed5228ba5a7464288243b7e0c3a.jpg
If you've played the previous chapters on Steam or Patreon, you can import your Realm 2 exported save into this demo and continue your journey.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44640344/b9865fa39cc8188aee11aff6ad0965441ee4cb5d.jpg
Depending on who you chose as your allies in the previous chapter, some of the content available in the demo changes. You can use the immersive recap to simulate a save for both sides to experience all of the demo's content.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44640344/bf2e2ad057f3f7c87681be06e82159b32b6fe50e.jpg
You can download it now from the High Lathión store page. We hope you enjoy this preview before our full release next month.

While you're here, please consider adding us to your wishlist. Thanks so much for your support!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2580130

notes.title: Our Immersive Recap!
notes.content:
Add us to your wishlist!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2580130

The story of The Seven Realms - High Lathión continues the first two chapters: Terran and Pythonium.

If you have already played the first two parts, you can import your end-game save into High Lathión when it launches.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44640344/a9dcfe1a37701e7bcf5ba21147c2d60ff82c467e.jpg
If you do not have an exported save or are new to The Seven Realms, you can start with this instalment.

Over the last few weeks, we've been creating an immersive recap/save simulator.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44640344/839c927aa0af215c112691d0f4c3a156c26bd41a.jpg
What does that mean?
When you select New Game in High Lathión, you will be shown a recap that takes you through the events of Terran and Pythonium. You can also select critical choices that will be carried into your new game.

We've enhanced the Terran images in the recap to match the style more closely to our later Realms.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44640344/620d569e92cb7342b0dbdc974d41841c2d837689.jpg
This feature will allow returning players to refresh their memories and for new players to jump straight into this Realm.

If you have any questions, let us know in the comments!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44640344/1a77948e351e1306e63a599e6933d08979614c13.jpg

notes.title: Character Side Stories
notes.content:
Add us to your wishlist!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2580130

Today, we'll share more information about the side paths in High Lathión. (Note that the images in this post do not contain the final lighting or rendering, so they are not as they will appear in game.)

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44640344/4a0337ef07953402d0f574b253f76e9914d63d4f.jpg
In The Seven Realms, there are a vast number of characters. Not all of them will be central to the main plot of each realm.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44640344/349f80400f54dce941c95543ced42ef244fe36dd.jpg
To ensure that no matter the contents of the main story, starting from this realm, numerous characters will have their own "side paths" for players to experience.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44640344/6dcbc0aaa3eded982feb702f8263ccd291b38647.jpg
These side stories revolve around the love interests, harem members and a couple of other characters.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44640344/b9c0f51ace90c00fd5914222f77e7fb4fee5a318.jpg
Some of these will be shorter, self-contained stories, while most others will be parts of a story that plays out across several realms.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44640344/0509984ad60922e150685c1a40ca45c5fa0e1580.jpg
We plan to include several of these in High Lathión when we release it on Steam; we will add others in a free update after the release.

The characters who will have a side path starting in this realm are:

 Leyala
 Kali
 Naya
 Gina
 Mei & Ling Guo
 Yuki
 Tasha
 Kagome
 Seraphina
 Lilin
 Zyair

In the Zyair path, our supporters on Patreon voted for two custom women for Atlas to hook up with in this path.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44640344/d2637bd8138ea7485061867242c05d87be8023f6.jpg
We're excited to share these side stories with you soon!

notes.title: New Cinematics!
notes.content:
Add us to your wishlist!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2580130

Cinematics
With High Lathión, our objective with animations is not only to have lewd ones but also exciting cinematics to enhance the experience.

From quenching your thirst
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44640344/59e0671e144b5220f812d627e41cbf0af8f8a583.gif

To making an entrance in the Elven Palace
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44640344/552d4d95e0a992dc1ab58857a2f5429c659510c2.gif

And, of course, fights (work-in-progress)
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44640344/6baf3d4c82deb606ec3c02d545d9d47625e779d3.gif

Numerous Angles
All lewd animations have four different angles to view. You can change them at will.

We started this in Realm 2, Pythonium, but we've expanded this further in High Lathión. All of our animations have so much more detail than ever before!

Here's a brief gameplay example below (heavily compressed to fit the post)
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44640344/16b294ff85f285abe63c79b3c01c9fe66830050c.gif

Sound Effects
Another exciting new feature in High Lathión is our use of sound effects. All animations (both lewd and not) are complete with sounds.

We can't share videos of them here, but you can check out some previews we've shared on our Twitter page.

Adding these sounds helps bring the scenes to life, especially the lewd ones... We can't wait for you to check them out when High Lathión releases soon!

notes.title: Moon & Sun Elves!
notes.content:
Add us to your wishlist!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2580130

Elves are the native and predominant species living in High Lathión.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44640344/f7ee8ec10a035ca1ac457e9629d30b0aec17ed04.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44640344/dffd2bdb711a3e32bdc8b12d9f5f9cd8cc3108bd.jpg
They are immortal, and once they surpass their first 100 years, it is common for them to stop keeping track of their age. They can still be killed, but time alone will not.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44640344/6336b345bd7adadfd4e7afa7503f47563eeed3f5.jpg
Elves, with their pointy ears, healthy physique, and significant physical strength, are a formidable species. Their innate abilities enable them to perform varying degrees of lesser magic.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44640344/7261f4bde33e242a1e3b8e2ff802232a82c2b0bf.jpg
Elves are split into two distinct groups: Moon Elves and Sun Elves.

Moon Elves have blue skin and are generally physically stronger than Sun Elves. Their insides are generally much cooler than that of other species, too.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44640344/bd75e06d023765af3b5c79495b5a4aa92b4e938a.gif
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44640344/eb9c6faa40fd849b83769cceeafc5968f05a8f92.jpg
Sun Elves have a yellow-brown skin tone, are typically more dexterous, and have more magical capabilities than Moon Elves.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44640344/39a4df759498901cf30566ddf10d1b7b3ecab375.gif
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44640344/3f2ac04acbaedab9285449d1dcc69618c90b2747.jpg
The two groups harbour a deep-rooted hatred for each other. Civil War consumed High Lathión for an eternity until the Sun Elf Queen and the Moon Elf King allied to unite the realm.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44640344/7bd30cc40f369188e66bf045f45b45b2e45ffa66.jpg
Although the move was controversial, both monarchs are deeply respected by their people and have managed to bring a large degree of peace to the realm.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44640344/2b2d8eaa0a872366078430d73ad9a6fdd2c2af62.jpg
The upcoming realm introduces two new harem members. Morwen and Idril.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44640344/622d279ab065ecbe4cc9b469fdf23d199a1282cd.jpg
We will share some more details about these two in posts soon!

The Seven Realms - Realms 1 & 2 are currently on our biggest discount ever. 40% off of everything, even more if you buy them bundled together!

notes.title: A Vision of High Lathión
notes.content:
Add us to your wishlist!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2580130
The next chapter of our story takes place in High Lathión.

In the group's quest to save someone dear, they must track down a rare plant located only in the Realm of Elves.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44640344/fd48d07f03d30c56b96a628ff3f415e51104f581.jpg
Locations

High Lathión is a stunning realm. We loved bringing this realm to life with the environments.

From historical cities
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44640344/19e358acd713f0dfe23a876ffb09f4b00358b2de.jpg
(Find a private spot)
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44640344/09505e79f884c02b21dca32d809639ea4dda46a6.gif
To vibrant green landscapes
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44640344/b9320b4ef2e385bc9d0d90e2e619bf611997fd6c.jpg
(Enjoy some time in the training grounds)
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44640344/2a86d723365cf3c51f6f668f0fba7f85376886b4.gif
And, of course, a beautiful palace
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44640344/eaaaa790126b7f49d7dd72f5630443bc3f0ea860.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44640344/fd4a834d23b08f1132553dd773deddb31912f8e7.jpg
(Make yourself at home in the guest rooms)
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44640344/198b3ae19c19ba75127ef22d9b10b08f2c4e77e9.gif

A Brief History
Civil War consumed High Lathión for an eternity. Moon Elves and Sun Elves slaughtered each other by the millions.

A pact between two brave elves ended the cycle of war. But even if they found peace, that doesn't mean everyone is happy with how things are now.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44640344/5b97b4721a4e077efc9faf0cc1c10c2e0d5c0ded.jpg
The inhabitants of High Lathión are almost entirely elves. Very few, if any, other species live here, and very few elves leave to live in different realms.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44640344/a9e4b742fccb8110acd85e0b5d0c832f55356d71.jpg
We will explore the elves in more detail in our next post!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44640344/89d9af3ebebc1114ea080bca4068bf8779450e08.jpg
The Seven Realms - Realms 1 & 2 are currently on our biggest discount ever. 40% off of everything, even more if you buy them bundled together!

notes.title: Enhanced Animation Previews!
notes.content:
Hey everyone,

We're excited to share some previews of our new and enhanced animations for The Seven Realms: High Lathión.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44640344/ada50a59e177e7e8b860a6ba24fcfedba4f50279.gif

As in Realm 2, you can switch between angles when watching the animations. All lewd animations have four angles you can switch between as desired.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44640344/3d0099316edc48aee5695f1bff4c32b80e0353ce.gif

All lewd scenes will be rewatchable in the gallery once unlocked on any of your saved games.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44640344/e3f3df6289b93e22073f052700c14da61b42ad51.gif

The main story will contain numerous scenes involving the three main girls and the two new elven ladies. You can also experience spicy scenes with your chosen ally from Pythonium and some of the ladies you met during the first Realm of Terran.

notes.title: Development Update & Previews!

Hey everyone,

It's been a while since we've shared a development update here on Steam.

We've been working hard to release early access updates on other platforms in preparation for the full Steam launch.

We are approaching the end of development of High Lathión's main story.

Once this is complete, we will implement the in-game side paths for numerous characters. We may release on Steam before completing all character side paths and then to add the remaining ones as a free update shortly after release.

We hope to launch High Lathión on Steam within the next two months. We will confirm specific release dates within the next few weeks.

notes.title: Introducing: A College of Thirst & Claws
notes.content:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2944560

A College of Thirst & Claws (ACTC) is an immersive, story-driven adult visual novel.

Forge meaningful connections with beautiful women as you shape your own story.


You can check out the store page here!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44998279/12330316520b35612b541530aab182dcd3620489.jpg
You and your twin sister, Mika, spent your lives in a werewolf pack, where your father is the Alpha. He harbours a deep hatred towards you and isolates you from the outside world.

When your father abruptly forces you to leave your pack and attend a unique college where supernatural beings mingle with humans, it's a chance for a fresh start in a place unlike any you've known.

However, after making a dangerous decision, you've found yourself in a sinister plot far beyond anything you anticipated.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44998279/6919481f0bf353c4990a5c2ba67d71a9e39f88a5.jpg
ACTC consists of seven main love interests. 

You can expect numerous high-quality sex scenes throughout the story, as well as stunning cinematics, to give you an even more immersive experience.

Your play style will have a direct impact on the sex scenes. Will you lean into your Alpha werewolf side and dominate, or will you come with a gentler approach?

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44998279/b3b83e4f0c0cca7d3780467c38d45188aa0ed55a.gif

We will reveal more about our love interests as we approach the game's release and share some previews of these sex scenes in action.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44998279/2c09a4616ec13693c94dec4786c31f18f0af4ae8.jpg
What else can you expect?

 A character-driven story shaped by your choices.
 Over 10,000 gorgeous images.
 Detailed cinematics to enhance your experience.
 A range of voice-acted sex scenes that will vary depending on your playstyle.
 An evolving glossary to help you keep track of the characters and lore.
 Original music and sound effects, designed for the story.
 A sex scene replay gallery and image favouriting to revisit memorable moments.
 A range of achievements and other unlockables.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44998279/0ae805f06753dbc62c3b7ecbfaf4e69749a91601.jpg
ACTC is set in the same universe as The Seven Realms, but it follows a new group of characters. No prior knowledge is needed to enjoy ACTC, but having played The Seven Realms, you may notice some references and easter eggs.

We're excited to share more details with you in the coming months. Be sure to wishlist and follow the game for more updates.

Wishlisting the game helps us enormously, so if you like what you see, please consider wishlisting the game and sharing our page with others!

We're still hard at work on the next chapter of The Seven Realms: High Lathión. ACTC is being worked on by our second development team.

You can also join our growing community on Discord. We'd love to chat with you all about the game!

notes.title: High Lathión - The Next Chapter
notes.content:
We're excited to share some information on the next chapter of The Seven Realms: High Lathión. We plan to share more frequent development updates here; however, we will be sharing these in English only for now. Apologies to fans playing in different languages!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44640344/fa4d3d22f1908ed5228ba5a7464288243b7e0c3a.jpg
The increase in the scope of High Lathión compared to Terran and Pythonium is significant. We are putting everything we've got into improving the graphics, storytelling, and overall player experience, and we can't wait to share more with you.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44640344/7a6dece9fd4a65e02784cdfaf28e6e072206c12a.jpg
High Lathión is the realm of Elves. Harmony has been found after endless wars between the moon and sun elves, but something sinister begins to threaten that peace.

Please consider adding the game to your wishlist. Doing so helps us enormously. Thanks for your support!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44640344/23b5ff3e80e5a27bda5bf868ae560d3b235f21aa.gif
New Characters
Amongst several new exciting characters, including the Elven King & Queen, you will meet two new harem members.

Morwen is the head servant in the royal Elven palace.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44640344/16264081b7f6a4b5e2eb7062c86a560de04b3b5a.jpg
Idril is a high-ranking member of the Elven military.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44640344/b9865fa39cc8188aee11aff6ad0965441ee4cb5d.jpg
Both of them will assist you in your journey, as you will assist them... and enjoy a few romantic encounters along the way...

Images
We've put in a lot of work to enhance the images in High Lathión. Compared to the darker tones in Terran and Pythonium, High Lathión is a bright, and vibrant realm, with images created to reflect its beauty.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44640344/2c78be64beb66e37214e781d924818178a6b4197.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44640344/a7e220b06bc8b02659cf2d1445cb28319260c433.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44640344/c03d8d1afef7ae6d4bbbb4da21012413b8eac14a.jpg
As we did with the climax in Pythonium, we're taking our action sequences to the next level to show off the power behind these supernatural beings.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44640344/2a899524ca84cfc20db08462f9e847ef51bddfb1.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44640344/643abd6eac7a5a57f0d102a0004c0815d299d7cb.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44640344/bf2e2ad057f3f7c87681be06e82159b32b6fe50e.jpg
Animations
The animations have always been important to us. In High Lathión, we're upgrading them further than before. While most animations featured are sexual, we also have short cinematics to immerse you further in the world with these characters.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44640344/552d4d95e0a992dc1ab58857a2f5429c659510c2.gif

Also, in this realm, we are adding more sounds. This includes sound effects during gameplay and all animations, especially the sexual ones. We'll share more on this in due course. If you want a preview of some voiced animations, you can check them out on our Twitter.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44640344/335ec7b4574b933b629872fc1159809c86cbecfb.gif
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44640344/5b1e2ab9d2b905a491d0c1277420e7947c1d9390.gif

Music
We love music and believe having a unique soundtrack enhances the gaming experience. All of the tracks featured in Terran and Pythonum were composed for the game. With High Lathión, we've taken this further by creating a whole new soundtrack for the realm, with longer individual music tracks. While some of the previous main themes still feature throughout, the new music, designed specifically for the Elven realm, should give the story a fresh feel when playing.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44640344/e28694dc1932c092b674532ebdfde1ca6bf39521.png
User Interface & Glossary
The user interface has also received a complete overhaul. We have completely redesigned the look to fit the theme of the Elven realm. Much of the functionality is similar, so it should still feel familiar if you've already played Terran and Pythonium.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44640344/60df43f56bac6046bbb112fb62c94db76b00ff9f.png
Completing specific actions will unlock new wallpapers for the title menu as you play. Once unlocked, you can change these at will. Will you keep your favourite character there once unlocked, or will you rotate these each time you play?

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44640344/625133a96726f97462e3ec45425364d24920b332.gif

We're also adding an evolving glossary. The glossary will update as you play and reveal more information, so you can easily catch yourself back up even if you return to the game after a little while.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44640344/e69558bd25359c6396427ece73c9d42716cca689.gif

Check details of character, species, realms or other key terms.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44640344/d70e8d0c3267ab3f9cce77637805a4884e5787ef.png

Side paths
Another exciting new addition to High Lathión is the character side paths.

These are side stories within the game that focus on individual characters. Will you help Gina save her brother? Will you help Yuki grow more independent? Spend time with various characters to develop your relationships further.

With a growing cast of characters, not all of them will be involved in every section of the main story, so these side paths ensure you spend time with your favourite characters, even if they aren't at the centre of the action.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44640344/8007aff34b37ec5b0051f866fbef9874d34d7665.gif

We can't wait to share more with you!

As soon as we have a definite release window, we will communicate it, but our current objective is to release High Lathión before the end of this year.

What are you looking forward to the most? Let us know if you have any questions!

notes.title: Kali: The Lost Soul
notes.content:
Kali is the last of the three main Love Interests we meet.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42982229/cad5d85bd2f47c80bad743c591ff7ba5562c9ef2.png

She is a powerful half-sprite who doesn’t hesitate to make hard decisions when needed. 
She distrusts strangers and prefers to keep to herself due to her complicated upbringing by fairies.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42982229/400b74cd7c9ac522a3af09685ebdd6f5bd2fa369.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42982229/9faac7fbbb3cc8dd40d9be4c479020fe91b4a49d.jpg
A Monochrome world through her eyes
She sees the world in black and white. You’re either with her or against her. And even if you’re with her, she, in her cynicism, expects you to betray her eventually. It’s easy for her to hate people, but when she loves, she loves you to the moon and back.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42982229/e695ad76678c3fb7ae574be0542a4514c2ead815.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42982229/4d0e32e8c14ff8fff1dcbc8bd9a75ed6001a3408.jpg
Conflicts between love and mistrust
During the story of The Seven Realms, your choices can lead her to learn that it’s not her against the world anymore and that she can trust you. In that case, her love for you will never waver. Or you can teach her that even love is a feeling she needs to be wary of. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42982229/ec99536cdc1b814ff0673d037e25801c4a47d75a.jpg
So, will you destroy her walls or teach her to erect stronger ones?

You can be with her in The Seven Realms: Terran & Pythonium.

Continue your story with her in High Lathión, coming later this year. You can wishlist it now!

notes.title: Naya: The Moon Killer
notes.content:
Naya is another one of the Love Interests. While she's an optional romantic partner, she's deeply involved in the story nonetheless.

She's the only female Alpha werewolf born in The Seven Realms, and a dark prophecy shrouds her life.
To the world, she is known as a "cursed being" who will come to devour a goddess that several realms worship. But to us, she's our little "pup". 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42982229/ea8bb5658bd0445acc50da08061ff7608286eefe.jpg
Taming the Ferocity
Creating and writing her is both easy and challenging. It's easy because we have all her lore in our heads, but difficult because she's soft and hard. She's innocent and harsh. She needs guidance while being a strong leader.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42982229/5e5cf76208959cae71e3c0ba05c4fadb37e109b1.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42982229/02b12db8ed15cff93caae2e71ab24dfbb592aa9e.jpg
A World on Her shoulders.
We wanted to show her struggles with the weight of her responsibilities. She and Atlas have that in common and bond over it.

She is not used to showing her vulnerable side to people, but she does so with ease with Atlas.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42982229/6038b3a8c75ea5ae8117fb1a2bab4a325967bb49.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42982229/879648abafed71297b3d191c2dc063ea07aa0348.jpg
While playing the game, we hope you help her develop to her full potential and show the realms that she is, indeed, the Alpha of all Alphas.

Her story and destiny will continue to unravel as we travel through the realms, and we will see if fate is something worth defying.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42982229/c7741d7cb67abc756f7ed556741ba7ba22e0ef57.jpg

You can be with her in The Seven Realms: Terran & Pythonium.

Continue your story with her in High Lathión, coming later this year. You can wishlist it now!

notes.title: Leyala: The Damsel of Deliverance
notes.content:
We thought it might be fun to do some character showcases. Talk a little about them, and show off some pictures in the process.

If you like this or have suggestions for posts you'd want to see from us. Let us know in the comments!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42982229/c9fd4e9dd6711f638d6a62fa54d4bf1e717e1627.png

Leyala is the main Love Interest in The Seven Realms.
She's a "human" who gets thrown into this supernatural universe overnight and needs to adjust quickly to her new reality.

Thanks to her, we learn more about the world of The Seven Realms. As she asks questions and discovers more about the other species and laws of those worlds, the players discover them with her.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42982229/c86118bc4f2187285aff8b588434b8724dfd3b76.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42982229/d18a95ef5a1359e6d8e5b53edbb32f2e867fcf73.jpg
The Embodiment of Tenderness
While the world of The Seven Realms and its rulers can be brutal, we wanted Leyala to be more "human". Sometimes, her views can clash with others, but she's still trying to be good in this dark world.

As the main love interest and Atlas' bond mate, she's here to challenge and balance him, acting as his mirror. There is not only one solution to every problem.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42982229/1ee754c45a273605efd3efa8f7bdacc4463329bf.jpg
Bringing Her to Life
While creating Leyala, her personality needed to shine through. She may not be as strong-headed as some other characters, but she still knows what she wants and can voice her opinion. 
She's not perfect; nobody in The Seven Realms is, but she will continue to grow as the story progresses.

I hope you will continue learning about her and maybe love her as much as Atlas does while you journey through The Seven Realms.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42982229/f6aa082ff1ea6075acfc87511ed560066abe18f3.jpg
You can bond with her in The Seven Realms: Terran & Pythonium.

Continue your story with her in High Lathión; coming later this year. You can wishlist it now!

notes.title: Realm 2: Pythonium - Development Update
notes.content:
Hey everyone,

We want to give you a quick update on the current development of Realm 2 and the release date.

We have decided to push the release until August/September. A specific date will be communicated nearer the time. We recently lost our programmer from the project, which was a setback for us. Now with our current developer, we're working on a save export system, allowing you to export your saves safely to Realm 3 upon completion of Realm 2.

We also drastically raised the image and animation quality halfway through the development of Realm 2. We're now working on changing the lighting and quality of the first half. We've posed all the renders and animations for Realm 2. It is now just a case of lighting, rendering and enhancing these. We decided to increase the scope of the finale of Realm 2 by adding many more renders and animations (which made the finale of Realm 2 twice as big as planned), which delayed our release plans.

We don't regret this, as we think they will drastically improve the finale. However, we do apologise for the delay that it will cause.

In the meantime, we thought you would like to see new previews of Realm 2: Pythonium.

Thanks for all the support, everyone.
SeptCloud

notes.title: Realm 1 Update
notes.content:
Hey everybody,

We have released an update to The Seven Realms - Realm 1.

The biggest change here is the addition of a Simplified Chinese translation!
All other changes are detailed below:

 Corrected two untranslated lines in Russian and Spanish.
 A pop-up will now appear when you unlock a new gallery scene or music track.
 You can now save your favourite in-game images by clicking the heart icon on the top right of the screen. This will save the image. All favourited images are viewable in the Extras/Favourites Menu.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42982229/e8de72c44225b27f68f456750e5c1c843a2d8e47.png
If you haven't already, please wishlist Realm 2: Pythonium. Realm 2 will be a DLC to the base game, and once purchased, you can continue from your existing saves. You wishlisting it really helps us out!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42982229/200e47f89acacbcfc209e90507edf8496e62130c.jpg
Thanks for playing, and have a great day!
SeptCloud
